notes.title: Update v0.3 "Combat Sandbox"
notes.content:
First, a huge THANK YOU to our community! It is an honor to build the game alongside such a great group of gamers, and it's so rewarding to hear how much you enjoy the game!

This update will include: 

 So many bug fixes & optimizations!
 Unity XR integration framework for cross-platform distribution
 ​Full overhaul of enemy AI, combat logic and ragdoll configuration
 ​Grabable/Throwable enemies!
 ​New Environment: “Combat Sandbox”
 ​New throwable weapons
 ​New Weapon: 2-Handed War Hammer
 ​New Weapon: Machete
 ​New Enemy: Rotten Zombie

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453352/c3dbf95f0929eb02a8a86f763e4f08a4864e5870.gif
...much more brutality is coming in future updates with new weapons, new enemies, new environments and boss encounters!

Please join our Discord for early Beta access, and cool giveaways!

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453352/cd51ea0347fe0d3e1940095249c686f8b8497013.jpg
Thanks to all our awesome fans & supporters! 
We are working hard to constantly improve the game, and will continue to provide updates every week or two! Some awesome players found a couple bugs, and we smashed them! Thanks so much! 
[previewyoutube=aUDNihgaBOI;full][/previewyoutube]
Update #3 includes some cool new weapons, breakable helmets, more bug fixes, additional combat tweaks, and updates to our streamer tools.

New Enemy! 
Battle through the endless horde, and test your might against Drak, the Undead Barbarian.

New Weapons! 

 Two-handed Viking Axe ("Skrofnung")
 Short Sword ("Thorn")

Bug Fixes & Improvements 

 More breakable helmets!
 Skip tutorial (Left top button or Y button)
 Increase/Decrease lighting with +/- keys
 Tweaked enemy AI patterns and difficulty
 Optimization and stability improvements
 Enemy combat logic improvements (More to come!)
 Increased difficulty progression and enemy pacing
 Tweaked the tutorial for player controls
 A long list of minor bug fixes...

The feedback we have been receiving from players has been invaluable! Let us know what you think! If you have more feedback to give the developers, thoughts on the game, or ideas you have that you would like to see in future updates, let us know on the Discord! 

...also, here are a couple awesome videos from hilarious YouTubers TupacVR
 and VRWarehouse!
[previewyoutube=nXyAiBkKmN8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=bidA68Lr2Vw;full][/previewyoutube]
Enjoy!
-Chicken Waffle dev team

notes.title: Shadow of Valhalla - Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone supporting the Early Access! 
We are working hard to constantly improve the game, and will continue to provide updates every week or two:) 

Let us know what you think! If you have more feedback to give the developers, thoughts on the game, or ideas you have that you would like to see in future updates, let us know on the Discord! 

Bug Fixes 

 Stability improvements
 Increased difficulty
 Tutorial for player controls
 A slew of minor bug fixes, and tweaks to enemy AI patterns and difficulty.
 Enemy combat logic improvements (More to come!)
 Only 3 soul stones are now required to unlock each magic rune
 bHaptic Vest support has been added! (more haptic sequences coming soon!)


Enjoy!
-Chicken Waffle dev team
